summary: See what people and agents did across the workspace, by day, filtered by type or person.
intent: Block: what happened across a workspace. Events from people and agents, newest first and grouped by day (Today, Yesterday, then dates), each with an Avatar, a verb line, its object, a time and Badges; Type and Person filters; Open and Reply on each event; Load more at the end. A history variant shows one record's events (an invoice, say) on the shared rail with a time column and a status word. An agent variant shows an agent's steps on the same rail with Avatar markers: a sentence, a meta line and a reason per step, Undo with its deadline, Undone and Final steps, and no built-in filters (the page puts a FilterBar above it).
useWhen: a workspace or project activity page
catch up on what people and agents did since yesterday
jump from an event to the thing it happened to, or reply to a comment
one record's history, like an invoice created, sent, viewed and paid — variant="history"
an agent activity log where recent steps can be undone and the rest are final — variant="agent" under a page FilterBar
doNotUseWhen: the steps of one agent run — AgentTrail or RunDetail
a queue of things waiting on you — AgentInbox
toasts for what just happened — NotificationStack

events.note: { id, type: "comment" | "change" | "run" | "member" | "billing", actor: { id, name, kind?: "person" | "agent", src?, initials? }, verb, object, at: epoch ms | ISO string, detail?, status?: { label, tone? }, canReply? }[]. Any order; shown newest first in day groups. verb is lower case ("commented on") so the line reads actor + verb + object. variant="agent" takes { id, at: epoch ms | ISO string, actor: { id, name, initials? }, sentence: string | inline nodes, meta: string (agent · app · task · who allowed it), reason?: string, undo?: { until: epoch ms | ISO string, onUndo }, state?: "undone" | "final", note?: string }[] instead.

filters.note: Controlled { types: type[], people: actorId[] }. Empty arrays mean no filter on that axis. Filtering is over the loaded events; an app that filters on the server keeps filters controlled and replaces events.

onOpen.note: (eventId) => void. Each event gets an Open button (named Open + the object) when set.

onReply.note: (eventId) => void. Comment events get Reply (named Reply to + the actor) when set; canReply: false hides it on one event.

onLoadMore.note: () => void. Fetch the next page and append it to events.

hasMore.note: Load more shows when this is true and onLoadMore is set.

loading.note: Skeleton rows: the whole feed with no events yet, else under the list. Load more reads Loading… and ignores clicks, keeping focus.

now.note: Epoch ms for Today / Yesterday. Default the time of first render.

timeZone.note: IANA zone for day groups and times. Pass it when the server and the viewer may differ.

description.note: Line under the title. Default: how many events show, and how many match the filters.

variant.note: feed: Avatars, Type and Person filters, Open and Reply. history: one record's events on the rail Timeline and AgentTrail share (16px rail, 12px dot, 1px line), a time column when wide and the status word at the row end; no Avatars, filters or actions. agent: an agent's steps on that rail with an Avatar sm marker in place of the dot, a time column (space-10, mono) when wide, the sentence (struck when undone), a meta line and a reason; at the row end an sm outline Undo (Undo2) with a mono deadline ("14:22 · 8 min left", only until undo.until), or a soft Badge Undone (Undo2) or Final (Lock). No frame, no visible heading and no built-in filters: put it in a Card under the page's PageHeader and FilterBar. filters, defaultFilters, onFiltersChange, onOpen, onReply and the status chip props don't apply.

statusChips.note: string[] of status words, like ["Created", "Sent", "Paid"]. Shows All plus one chip each as a kit SegmentedControl (sm); a chip matches event.status.label.

statusChip.note: Controlled chip: a status word, or null for All. Leave it out for uncontrolled (starts on All).

error.note: The events could not load: the reason, shown under "Couldn't load activity". With no events it replaces the feed; with events it replaces Load more.

onRetry.note: () => void. Shows an outline Retry button in the error state.

layout: head: h2 and count line, with the filter group (Type, Person, Clear filters) at the end; it wraps under the title when narrow
one section per day, labelled by its h3 (Today, Yesterday, Mon 9 Nov), over a card-surface ordered list of events
an event row is Avatar, the copy (verb line, optional detail, time with Badges) and its actions at the end
the block is its own inline-size container; below --grid-breakpoint-sm (40rem) of block width the actions move under the copy

history: the block is one card (surface-card, border-faint, radius-xl). Each event is a time column (space-12, mono), the rail and the copy with the status word at the end; the rail line runs only to the next event of the same day. Below --grid-breakpoint-sm the time column goes and time and status join a meta line under the copy, and Load more fills the width

agent: no frame of its own (put it in a kit Card); the h2 and count line are screen-reader only. Days are split by a divider, each labelled by its h3 caption. A step is a time column (space-10, mono), the rail (Avatar sm, 1px line in --line-strong to the next step of the same day), the copy (sentence 14/20, meta and reason 12/16) and the end column (Undo over its deadline, or the Badge). Below --grid-breakpoint-sm the time column goes and the time leads the meta line, the end column moves under the copy (Undo beside its deadline), and an undone or final step with a note drops the line under the meta and shows the note beside its Badge. Load more reads Load earlier days and fills the width

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
each day is a section labelled by its h3, whose name carries the day's event count

each event is a list item that reads as one sentence: who (and that it is an agent), the verb, the object, any status, the detail, then the day and time; the visual row is hidden from screen readers so nothing is read twice
Open is named Open + the object and Reply is named Reply to + the actor, so a list of buttons is still clear
the filters are a group named Filter activity; Type and Person are kit FilterButtons that open a Popover dialog of kit Checkboxes in a fieldset; the chip's name carries the picked value or count
Load more is a real button described by the count line; while loading it stays focusable and says Loading…
what Load more brings in is announced in a polite status region ("5 more events loaded, 2 match the filters."); filter changes are announced there too
when the last page arrives and Load more goes away, focus moves to the first new event that shows
no motion of its own; Skeleton's shimmer stops under prefers-reduced-motion
history keeps the one-sentence list items; time, rail and status columns are hidden from screen readers, and the status word is part of the sentence, so colour never stands alone
status chips are a SegmentedControl radiogroup named Filter activity; a chip change is announced in the status region
the error state is a kit Empty with a real Retry button
agent: each step is a list item read in order (time, sentence, meta, reason, then Undo or the Badge); the Avatar marker is hidden since the meta names the agent
agent: Undo is a real button described by the step's sentence and its deadline; after the page marks the step undone, focus moves to that step
agent: Undone and Final are words in a Badge, and the strike only backs up Undone, so state is never shown by colour or line alone

doNot: Do not rebuild ActivityFeed from a local list; import the block
Do not put a solid primary in the feed; Open and Reply are ghost, Load more is outline
Do not put a sentence in verb; verb is the phrase between the actor and the object
Do not use Badge for people; Avatar is the person or agent, the Agent Badge only says it is an agent
Do not show status by colour alone; the status word is always there, tone only tints it
Do not build an agent step log from a local list; use variant="agent"
Do not show Undo after its deadline; pass state="final" with a note on what to do instead
snippet:
<ActivityFeed events={events} onOpen={openEvent} onReply={replyTo} onLoadMore={loadNextPage} hasMore={hasMore} loading={loading} />
<ActivityFeed variant="history" title="INV-1842 history" description="5 events · Northwind Ltd · €2,400.00" events={events} statusChips={["Created", "Sent", "Viewed", "Paid", "Refunded"]} onLoadMore={loadNextPage} hasMore={hasMore} />
<ActivityFeed variant="agent" title="Agent activity" events={steps} now={now} onLoadMore={loadEarlierDays} hasMore={hasMore} />
